94b25974d5.group_remark: `ChipletSelectors` struct now threaded as parameter; precomputed selector products (e.g. `ace_chiplet_flag`, `is_transition`) replace inline compositions from raw selector columns. The constraint polynomials are algebraically different because the selector factoring changed, but semantically equivalent under correct trace assignment.

39e1e3a01f.group_remark: New last-row constraints enforce all 5 chiplet selectors equal 1 at the final trace row. Note: 3 of 5 source expressions show a `let mut last = builder.when_last_row()` binding instead of the actual assertion due to a source-extraction artifact; the recorded fingerprints correspond to the `last.assert_one(...)` calls.

fa79579f7d.group_remark: `when_transition()` guard removed from chiplet constraints. Each constraint polynomial lost its `(1 - z_last)` factor. Soundness preserved because the preceding commit (`39e1e3a01f`) enforces all selectors = 1 on the last row, so every chiplet's derived `is_active` flag vanishes there, making the constraints auto-zero without the explicit transition guard. Polynomially non-equivalent but semantically equivalent under the last-row invariant.

7a366bde1f.group_remark: **Intentional non-equivalent change.** Per-bus domain tag added to `Challenges` encoding; each bus constraint polynomial now includes a distinct domain separator constant. This is a soundness improvement, not a refactor.

c14fd13f56.group_remark: Small helper function inlined; constraint expression unchanged, only call-site location moved.

0216cd69de.group_remark: Constraint style refactor: gates factored into `when()` chains, semantic assertions applied. 7 sign flips (`assert_zero(g*(1-x))` to `when(g).assert_one(x)`) and 3 constraints gained `is_transition` factor (`when_transition().when(flag)` where the flag is an op flag that vanishes on the last row, so the constraint was already vacuous there). All changes are semantically equivalent.
